context.text: Chapter 4 tonight, Maya: 8 pm on the couch, about 20 minutes. Then a quick voice recap.

the habit stacking part, like tying a new habit to one you already do

Got it, Maya, 20 minutes is staying as is. Tomorrow is chapter 5 on the couch at 8 pm, same as tonight. In your voice recap, tell me if you tried the brush-teeth-then-stretch stack. Work for you?
